text:
Aisha: OK team — time for the weekly model intake / prioritization sync. I posted the new candidate list in the intake sheet (link) and pre-filled scores for latency and infra risk. Can folks quickly review and add quality/regression risk?

Tom: looking now. Quick note: Model X-3 has already failed our 8k-token perf test in quantized FP8 on A100s last week. Marking infra risk high until quantization path is verified. :warning:

Ravi: I skimmed evals — X-3 BLEU-ish is fine but hallucination rate up on our financial prompts. Suggest adding 'regression to LLM-finance-v1' check as a blocker for rollout.

Lena: +1 on the blocker. Also for prioritization scoring, can we weight customer impact x2 this sprint? Several sales leads asked about embeddings latency improvements.

Aisha: Good call. I'll update the rubric: final_score = 2*customer_impact + model_quality - infra_risk + ops_cost_savings. Putting a note: if regression to prod prompts >3% we set state=hold.

Tom: Uploading a short bring-up checklist for new model variants to the drive. Paste below in case anyone needs quick copy: ```
- Verify baseline (float32) end-to-end on prod-like infra
- Run quantization sweep (int8, nf4, fp8) and log token-per-sec
- Run 1000 financial QA prompts, measure hallucination/regression
- Run streaming latency SLO traces at 95th pct
- Smoke test function calls and tool-calling
- Add canary config: 1% traffic, fallback to stable model
```

Ravi: Tiny nit: add KV cache correctness check — we saw cache drift on the last rolling deploy.

Lena: Also add a quick perf/quality scatter plot export: perf on x-axis, ROUGE-BLEU on y. Helps visualize quant tradeoffs during review.

Aisha: Cool. For this week's intake I propose top 3 candidates: X-3 (high customer ask), Y-1 (low infra risk, modest perf wins), Z-quant (experimental, likely to need more eval cycles). Can everyone add a short justification in the sheet by EOD?

Tom: Done for X-3 — note that X-3 needs a quantization experiment on smaller sequence lengths first. Will run quant sweep Mon/Tue.

Ravi: Added Y-1 justification. I'll own the quality regression tests for Y-1.

model-bot: Deploy-checklist created: #1234, canary policy=1%, alerting hooks attached to latency/regression monitors.

Lena: For Z-quant, recommend tagging it as "research" and not pulling into Dedicated until perf matures. I'll add a short note in roadmap column so PMs don't schedule it prematurely.

Aisha: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Tom — post quant sweep results in this thread; Ravi — run regression set and flag if >2% regression; Lena — update roadmap column. We'll hit scoring review in next model-review meeting (Wednesday 11am). If anything blocks earlier, ping here. :rocket:
